## Generate tables and figures

Generate all auto_tables and auto_figures with statistical results:
```{r make_all_auto}
# Settings:
do_print <- interactive()
tlf_reg <- get_metadata()

# All combination of chapter and estimand that need processing:
cases <- tlf_reg[estimand != "intro" & grepl("auto", folder), 
                 .(estimand = unique(estimand), N = .N), .(chapter)]
chapters <- cases[, unique(chapter)]

## Generate all tables and figures for each chapter:
tmp <- lapply(chapters, function(ch) { # ch <- chapters[3]
  mk_tlf_ch(chapter   = ch,
            estimands = cases[chapter == ch, estimand], 
            tlf_reg   = tlf_reg,
            set       = "auto",
            verbose   = do_print)
})
```
